item.title: Kapil Sharma cafe firing: Shooters Sharry, Diljot, Seepu behind attack identified, pictures released
item.description: Singh reportedly supplied weapons and vehicles to Sharry and Diljot on the instructions of gangsters Sonu (Rajesh Khatri) and Goldy Dhillon. The firearms used in the three shootings were provided through this network.

item.title: SSC CHSL Tier 1 answer key 2025 out at ssc.gov.in; know how to raise objections
item.description: SSC CHSL Tier 1 answer key 2025: The SSC CHSL tier one answer key objection window will remain open till December 11, the candidates who wish to raise objection on answer key can do so on the official website- ssc.gov.in. The SSC CHSL tier one answer key objection fee is Rs 50 per question.

item.title: Box Office collection [December 8, 2025]: Dhurandhar roars; Tere Ishk Mein sees first drop
item.description: Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar is roaring at the box office. Kriti Sanon–Dhanush starrer Tere Ishk Mein witnessed its first-ever drop on its second Monday.

item.title: Do cold plunges work for women? UK physician breaks it down
item.description: Cold plunges are touted to boost immunity, lift mood, and speed up recovery. But do they actually work for women? Dr Sermed Mezher, a popular health educator from the UK, breaks it down.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: Landowner alleges irregularities, says 'fighting a battle for the last 20 years'
item.description: Birch by Romeo Lane owners have reportedly fled to Thailand after the fire incident. The Goa Police is preparing to seek Interpol’s assistance to trace the two brothers.

item.title: Mahindra XUV700 facelift to launches as XUV 7XO, showcases new design in latest teaser
item.description: Launched in 2021, the Mahindra XUV700 is set to receive a facelift, debuting on January 5. The new model will be introduced as the XUV 7XO, aligning with Mahindra's updated nomenclature for its ICE vehicles.

item.title: Why most Indian women miss early heart attack symptoms and how to identify them
item.description: Many Indian women don’t experience the classic chest-pain symptoms of a heart attack. Instead, they show subtle warning signs that often go unnoticed. Discover what doctors say about the real symptoms women should watch for and how to identify a heart attack early.

item.title: Chinese citizen held in Srinagar over visa violation visited Ladakh without permission, phone seized
item.description: Upon arrival in India, the accused obtained an Indian SIM card from an open market, which raised further suspicion. His browsing history showed searches related to CRPF deployment and the abrogation of Article 370

item.title: IndiGo crisis: 'No law should unnecessarily create trouble for people,' says PM Modi at NDA meeting
item.description: Divulging the details of the meeting, Union Minister Kiren Rijiju said PM Modi instructed all the lawmakers to work towards making the lives of people easier in their respective constituencies.

item.title: DU SOL admit card 2025 out at sol.du.ac.in; how to download
item.description: DU SOL admit card 2025: The DU SOL hall ticket has been released for the first, third, fifth and seventh semester exams. The DU SOL hall ticket download link is sol.du.ac.in.
